capabilities: shorten the stacked-tab sliding animation to an adjustable 40-400 ms duration
preserve the horizontal sliding animation instead of disabling it
leave regular tabs and scrolling elsewhere unchanged
restore native scrolling when the plugin is disabled
extras: The README states the plugin accesses no note contents, makes no network requests, and stores only the animation duration setting.
intentEvidence: Faster Stacked Tabs replaces only that horizontal scroll with a shorter, adjustable ease-out animation.
problem: Obsidian's stacked tabs use native smooth scrolling with a fixed, non-configurable duration, so switching between stacked tabs feels slow.
summary: Tab-switching tweak that replaces the slow native scroll in stacked tab groups with a shorter, adjustable ease-out animation.
